### 🛡️ Standard PR Verification (Humans & Agents)
- [ ] Feature branch changes are isolated on a named branch (`feat/*`, `fix/*`, `refactor/*`, `workflow/*`)
- [ ] `npm run test:all` passes 100% (0 errors, all vitest unit tests pass)
- [ ] Bug fixes or new features include corresponding unit tests
- [ ] Commits use `--no-gpg-sign` and standardized prefixes (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `workflow:`)

### 🤖 AI Agent Verification (Required for AI Assistant / Agent PRs Only)
- [ ] Explicit user directive was given in the chat prompt specifically requesting to create this PR (e.g. "make a pull request and push to main")
